{{Quote|We're all civilians here, Jedi. Galactic Alliance Storage handles property, not pris&mdash;''"<br />"''Never lie to a Jedi, Sergeant.|Weeze and Jaina Solo|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
'''Weeze''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in [[Galactic Alliance Security]]. By [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], he was stationed as a guard at a [[Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81|secret]] [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]] were being held in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. In 43.5 ABY, he and another Rodian, [[Rosii]], attempted to prevent [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] access to the Horns. Weeze quickly panicked, triggering an alarm just before a large group of Jedi and press arrived. Solo then presented a legal document allowing them all access to the Horns, and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]], who had just arrived with an assault [[Squad/Legends|squad]], was forced to allow them to enter.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Sergeant Weeze, this is a legal writ granting us visitation rights for Valin and Jysella Horn, who, as you can see by the accompanying incarceration order, are being held at a secret Galactic Alliance Security detention center located at this address.''"<br />"''I&hellip;I don't know what you're talking about. This is just a storage facil&mdash;|Jaina Solo and Weeze|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
[[File:Jaina_Apocalypse.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Weeze attempted to prevent Jaina Solo from entering the detention facility.]]
Weeze was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who served in [[Galactic Alliance Security]] in the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Abyss" /> In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. As ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third installment of the series, is dated to 43 ABY by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', its events must take place in 43.5 ABY.</ref> he held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] and was stationed as a guard at [[Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81|Detention Center 81]], a secret [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], under the command of [[Yaka]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Wruq Retk]]. Two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]], developed a [[Force psychosis|mysterious psychosis]],<ref name="Abyss" /> and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|decided]] to [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encase]] them in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]],<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> eventually placing them in the blockhouse in which Weeze was stationed.<ref name="Abyss" />

The [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] discovered their location, however, and [[Mind trick/Legends|tricked]] [[Arabelle Lorteli]], the head [[Judge/Legends|judge]] of the [[Court of Jedi Affairs]], into giving them a document allowing them visitation rights to the Horn siblings. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] approached and Weeze another Rodian, [[Rosii]] at the security counter in the lobby. Weeze claimed to be suprised by a Jedi seemingly being a client, and asked for her vault number and password, but Solo insisted he already knew that she did not have one. Weeze insisted they could not help her and directed her on where to open a vault. Solo then requested to see the Horns, but the Rodians feigned innocence, pretending the building was simply a storage facility.<ref name="Abyss" /> 

When Solo continued to insist on seeing the horns and also read Weeze's mind to learn his rank, Weeze panicked and pressed an alarm button, causing Solo to [[Telekinesis/Legends|push]] the Rodians backward and toss aside their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as a group of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] and press arrived. As Solo finally presented the document to an afraid Weeze&mdash;who still denied that the facility was used for anything more than storage&mdash;a Galactic Alliance assault [[Squad/Legends|squad]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]] arrived. The Jedi then showed the visitation rights to Atar, who was forced to allow them access to the Horns. Later, Galactic Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] arrived, and Weeze and Rosii nervously followed behind her.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I didn't know we had any ''Jedi'' clients. Vault number and password?''"<br />"''I don't have either. But you already know that.|Weeze, greeting Jaina Solo|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Weeze was corpulent and rather fearful of Jedi. Alongside Rosii, a fellow Rodian, Weeze ineffectually attempted to convince Jedi Knight Jaina Solo that the blockhouse was just a storage facility, and continued feigning innocence even when faced with legal documents.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|We can't help you at this door. You'll have to go over to main reception and rent a vault from an account representative.|Weeze feigns innocence to Jaina Solo|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Weeze and Rosii both failed to convince Jedi Knight Jaina Solo that the building was merely a storage facility, and failed to attack her with their blasters before she knocked them down and disarmed them.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Equipment==
Weeze carried a blaster and wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] paramilitary [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] with the [[Writing/Legends|words]] "Galactic Alliance Storage" embroidered in yellow on one of its pockets and a name patch sewn on it.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Weeze appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'' the third novel in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, which was written by [[Troy Denning]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="Abyss" />
